tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Intel launches a new GPU chip designed to challenge NVIDIA. Reported by 鉅亨網: Intel is introducing its AI-focused GPU D-Series with partners for data center artificial intelligence inference.
XAI is launching a subscription combination. Reported by Moomoo: users are being prompted to enable JavaScript for website functionality.
NVIDIA and Cisco are introducing a new pluggable optical transceiver form factor to expand artificial intelligence factories. Reported by 36氪: the new technology is designed to support data center expansion.
Anthropic brings 10 free courses to Coursera. Reported by EdTech Innovation Hub: Anthropic launches 10 free artificial intelligence courses on Coursera for teachers, developers, and small-business owners.
Microsoft unveils an artificial intelligence chip called Maia 300. Reported by 뉴스웨이: Microsoft says it cannot rely only on NVIDIA for its artificial intelligence chip needs.
Free every hour.
